subject: Social Media
title: Digital Exile
description: A quick win: understand Digital Exile.

hook.text: Deplatformed from every service, a person loses their bank, email, cloud storage, and social life in one weekend.

buildup.text: When platforms coordinate bans, effects cascade. Parler lost hosting, app stores, and payment processors at once.

discovery.text: Digital infrastructure is controlled by a handful of firms. Being banned by three erases your online existence.

twist.text: This power has no due process. No appeal court. No transparent criteria. Companies decide who exists online.

climax.text: Supporters call it accountability. Critics call it digital exile. Both acknowledge: private power replaces state power.

punchline.text: Exile used to mean leaving a country. Now it's a ban.

quiz.question: What makes coordinated deplatforming especially powerful?
